verdict.rationale: AMD's MI325X system acceptance guide documents an 8-GPU OAM platform with 2TB of HBM3 and fully-meshed Infinity Fabric connectivity between accelerators. Instinct docs cover cluster-scale deployment through a Cluster Validation Suite, Kubernetes GPU Operator, device plugin, Slurm-compatible scheduler, and cluster-wide profiling. ROCm adds communication primitives plus vLLM/SGLang serving recipes. Missing for 10: documented Infinity Fabric bandwidth figures, MI325X-specific rack-scale/multi-node scale-out reference designs (the cluster tooling is generic Instinct), and independent or hands-on corroboration of datacenter-scale training on this part.
